The unrelated `CHANGELOG.md` "Ideas" edit and `scratch/` remain exactly as they were before, untouched and uncommitted.

## Summary

**Bug:** `lib/slugify.js` replaced each non-alphanumeric character individually (`replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '-')`), so runs of separators produced multiple dashes and trailing separators left a trailing dash (e.g. `'Hello,  World!'` → `'hello--world-'`).

**Fix:** collapse consecutive non-alphanumeric characters into a single dash, then trim leading/trailing dashes:
```js
return String(input)
  .toLowerCase()
  .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
  .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
```
`lib/truncate.js` was not touched.

**Verification (TDD, per systematic-debugging skill):**
1. Added regression tests first (collapsing runs, trimming edges, empty string, separators-only string) — confirmed they failed against the old implementation (3 failures).
2. Applied the fix and reran `node --test` — all 8 tests pass, including the pre-existing truncate tests (unaffected).

**Commit `63c5468`** contains only `lib/slugify.js`, `test/strutil.test.js`, and the new "Unreleased" CHANGELOG bullet — staged precisely via a crafted blob so the pre-existing uncommitted "Ideas" section in `CHANGELOG.md` and the untracked `scratch/` directory were left exactly as they were, unstaged/untracked.
